verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI API platform, but the evidence documents no rule engine or trigger-to-action configuration. Managed Agents webhooks only notify a consumer of state changes, so acting on them requires the developer to build the automation. "Hand off and schedule tasks" describes scheduling, not event-driven rules. Tool use and SDKs are building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
